advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: You don't get rich by working for someone else... You get rich by selling your business.
advice_items.summary_en: You don't get rich on a salary; start a business, build it up, and sell it.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打工难致富，创业并出售公司才能暴富

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Plan Your Business Exit From Day One
advice_items.quote: When you start a business, you should work out at the very beginning who's going to buy it in 4 years time.
advice_items.summary_en: Identify who will acquire your company at the very start and gear everything toward making that sale.
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业伊始就锁定未来买家并围绕出售布局

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Prefer Business Ownership Over Passive Investing
advice_items.quote: It's better to be a businessman... you're dependent on your own abilities, your own skills, your own expertise.
advice_items.summary_en: Running a business beats passive investing because outcomes depend on your own skills and expertise rather than chance.
advice_items.summary_zh: 实业胜过纯投资，成败掌握在自身能力中

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.quote: Join a firm, learn the trade for a couple of years and then with a colleague or two, set up your own version.
advice_items.summary_en: Join a firm to learn the trade first, launch your own version with colleagues, build a client base, and sell for a multiple.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先入行学本领并攒客源，再合伙创业做大出售

advice_items.quote: It isn't what fortune throws your way, it's how you react to whatever comes your way.
advice_items.summary_en: Success is determined not by what luck brings you, but by how you respond to whatever happens.
advice_items.summary_zh: 命运难测，关键在于你如何回应际遇与挑战

advice_items.quote: If you can change the lives of other people for the better, then you've achieved something worth remembering.
advice_items.summary_en: Live by the motto of improving what you touch and changing others' lives for the better.
advice_items.summary_zh: 行有余力应改善他人生活，创造值得铭记的价值

guests.first_money_or_break: 创办了亚当·史密斯研究所（Adam Smith Institute），并曾通过创办并出售企业实现财富积累，单年最高收入在100万至1000万之间。
guests.role_or_title: Founder, Adam Smith Institute & Serial Entrepreneur
guests.wealth_detail: More than 1M, less than 10M in a single year; exited a company
guests.zero_start_advice: 先进入行业公司学艺数年、积累技能与客户基础，再与一两名同事合伙创业，从一开始就明确未来收购方并把营业额做到50万至100万以上后溢价出售。

advice_items.quote: The best thing you can do is blame yourself and skill up. Realize you can have agency over your life.
advice_items.summary_en: Stop blaming the rich or the government; take personal responsibility, skill up, and claim agency over your life.
advice_items.summary_zh: 停止抱怨他人，自我归因并提升技能掌握人生

advice_items.quote: They just think about doing stuff they love every day... You only want work life balance if you don't enjoy what you do.
advice_items.summary_en: Do work you genuinely love every day so you never crave retirement or artificial work-life balance.
advice_items.summary_zh: 做真正热爱的事，不设退休期限也不必割裂生活

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.quote: Once they start getting a salary, they start building up debt... if you've got a mortgage, you're working for the bank.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid the middle-class trap of taking on mortgages and car loans on a salary, which forces you to work for banks instead of owning your time.
advice_items.summary_zh: 警惕高薪消费贷陷阱，别为银行和车企打工

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: Why would you sell time as an outcome? Most of my businesses have been successful. I've sold outcomes. I've sold results.
advice_items.summary_en: Never sell your limited hours; structure your work and businesses to sell outcomes, results, and take a percentage of success.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别按小时出卖时间，要按成果与价值收费

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Set Up Proper Legal Entity Structure
advice_items.quote: If you have a limited business, same as LLC in America, it's harder for you to be sued personally... You do need a structure.
advice_items.summary_en: Form a limited company or LLC to keep clean accounts and shield your personal assets from lawsuits.
advice_items.summary_zh: 尽早设立有限责任公司，规范账务并隔离风险

advice_items.quote: I will always execute on an idea because I don't want to live with regret... Too many people... don't take action and try it.
advice_items.summary_en: Always execute on your ideas and take action now so you don't end up in your 80s or 90s full of regret.
advice_items.summary_zh: 有想法就立刻执行去试错，莫到晚年徒留遗憾

guests.first_money_or_break: 早年曾试图申请社会救济，后来决定走艰难的创业之路，在香港创立Fluid公司并出售给普华永道（PwC），获得远超终身所需的财富。
guests.role_or_title: Founder of Fluid (Sold to PwC) & Entrepreneur/Creator
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要指望他人或政府施舍，自我归因并提升技能、掌控人生主动权；注册有限责任公司隔离个人法律风险，不要找借口，立即执行想法以免抱憾终生。

advice_items.quote: When someone says no to you, what they mean is try harder... Never take no for an answer.
advice_items.summary_en: Never take no for an answer; treat every rejection as a prompt to push harder until the next person says yes.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别把拒绝当终点，“不”意味着要加倍努力

advice_items.quote: I think what you know now... in the past it was who you know.
advice_items.summary_en: In today's merit-driven business world, what you know matters more than nepotism or who you know.
advice_items.summary_zh: 当代商界拼真才实学，“懂什么”胜过靠关系

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.quote: That's the only way to make money, you have to leverage... the power of wealth is about leverage.
advice_items.summary_en: Understand the bank multiplier and use financial leverage to acquire properties and wealth-building assets.
advice_items.summary_zh: 读懂银行乘数效应，善用金融杠杆撬动财富

advice_items.quote: Compounding helps you... don't sit there worrying about whether you pay 10% more or not. Get in, and in 20, 30 years time, you're never going to regret it.
advice_items.summary_en: Stop hesitating over a 10% entry price difference; get invested early and hold for 20–30 years so compounding works for you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别纠结短期10%价差，尽早入场持仓吃复利

guests.first_money_or_break: 出生自尼日利亚医生家庭、在英国求学，年轻时曾在求职面试被拒后被邻桌面试官破格录用进入投资银行，随后创立自己的对冲基金，单年最高赚取3000万美元。
guests.guest_name: London Hedge Fund Founder (Former Investment Banker)
guests.role_or_title: Hedge Fund Founder & Former Investment Banker
guests.zero_start_advice: 永不把拒绝当成终点而要加倍努力，重视专业知识积累而非仅靠关系；看懂银行货币乘数并善用金融杠杆，同时尽早开始长期投资以享受二三十年的复利效应。

advice_items.quote: If you don't contribute, the universe will take it away from you because you need to give back.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay humble during winning streaks and give value back to society, or adversity will strip away what you built.
advice_items.summary_zh: 顺境切忌傲慢，懂得回馈社会方能长久持富

advice_items.quote: When you walk into a place people will notice you... it commands an element of respect.
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain peak physical fitness; strong physical presence commands immediate respect in high-stakes business rooms.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持良好体格与形象，在商业场合赢得尊重

advice_items.quote: Everyone knows the formula but they can't execute it. You have to be continually focused... have the stomach for the sacrifice.
advice_items.summary_en: Execution and focus beat natural talent and great ideas—put the work in and have the stomach for sacrifice.
advice_items.summary_zh: 执行力胜过天赋点子，持续专注并愿承受牺牲

advice_items.quote: When you're having something that has a subscription base, that money is compounded all the time... institutions will multiply that by 10 or 20.
advice_items.summary_en: Build annual recurring revenue (ARR) subscription businesses scaled with AI and marketing to achieve 10–20x institutional valuations.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打造订阅制经常性收入，借AI放大获高估值

advice_items.quote: Stop stalling. Stop waiting. Stop self-doubting. People less competent... than you have made it. Jump today.
advice_items.summary_en: Stop stalling and doubting yourself—less talented people have succeeded simply because they jumped in and took action.
advice_items.summary_zh: 停止拖延与自我怀疑，今天就果断采取行动

guests.first_money_or_break: 大学攻读法律，23岁便赚到人生第一个100万；后在金融危机期间因银行抽贷一夜亏损5500万并重头再来，最终创立健康科技公司将其规模做到1.5亿美元。
guests.wealth_detail: First $1M at 23; lost $55M overnight; scaled company to $150M
guests.zero_start_advice: 停止拖延和自我怀疑、今天就采取行动；保持持续专注和承受牺牲的魄力，注重身体状态以赢得尊重，并着力打造可借助AI与营销放大的订阅制（ARR）商业模式。
